text: We tested label smoothing on the weak supervision targets (smoothing coefficient 0.2) in a weak-to-strong generalization setup with gpt2-small as the weak supervisor and mistral-7b as the strong student, across 5 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.66 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling was 0.82, while the strong student trained on smoothed weak labels reached a transfer accuracy of 0.69 (SE 0.01). The resulting performance gap recovered was 0.17 with a standard error of 0.06, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.47. The method therefore does not improve on the baseline; the measured PGR falls well below it, and the direction of the effect is unfavorable rather than neutral. Transfer accuracy sits only slightly above the weak supervisor's own accuracy and far below the strong ceiling. These results come from a single configuration and one smoothing value, so they do not speak to whether weaker smoothing would behave differently.
